mapper.sql: flight_booking_id, trip_id, booking_batch_id, user_id, leg, offer_id, provider, origin, destination, carrier_code, carrier_name, flight_number, departure_at, arrival_at, quoted_total_price, quoted_currency, quoted_price_source, quoted_at, user_reported_booked, user_reported_at, booking_ref, booking_ref_added_at, created_at, updated_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO flight_bookings ( trip_id, user_id, leg, offer_id, provider, origin, destination, carrier_code, carrier_name, flight_number, departure_at, arrival_at, quoted_total_price, quoted_currency, quoted_price_source, quoted_at ) VALUES ( #{tripId}, #{userId}, #{leg}, #{offerId}, #{provider}, #{origin}, #{destination}, #{carrierCode}, #{carrierName}, #{flightNumber}, #{departureAt}, #{arrivalAt}, #{quotedTotalPrice}, COALESCE(#{quotedCurrency}, 'KRW'), #{quotedPriceSource}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ) ON CONFLICT (trip_id, leg) DO UPDATE SET user_id = EXCLUDED.user_id, offer_id = EXCLUDED.offer_id, provider = EXCLUDED.provider, origin = EXCLUDED.origin, destination = EXCLUDED.destination, carrier_code = EXCLUDED.carrier_code, carrier_name = EXCLUDED.carrier_name, flight_number = EXCLUDED.flight_number, departure_at = EXCLUDED.departure_at, arrival_at = EXCLUDED.arrival_at, quoted_total_price = EXCLUDED.quoted_total_price, quoted_currency = EXCLUDED.quoted_currency, quoted_price_source = EXCLUDED.quoted_price_source, quoted_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, user_reported_booked = FALSE, user_reported_at = NULL, booking_ref = NULL, booking_ref_added_at = NULL

INSERT INTO flight_bookings ( trip_id, booking_batch_id, user_id, leg, offer_id, provider, origin, destination, carrier_code, carrier_name, flight_number, departure_at, arrival_at, quoted_total_price, quoted_currency, quoted_price_source, quoted_at, user_reported_booked, user_reported_at ) VALUES ( NULL, #{bookingBatchId}, #{userId}, #{leg}, #{offerId}, #{provider}, #{origin}, #{destination}, #{carrierCode}, #{carrierName}, #{flightNumber}, #{departureAt}, #{arrivalAt}, #{quotedTotalPrice}, COALESCE(#{quotedCurrency}, 'KRW'), #{quotedPriceSource}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, TRUE, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ) ON CONFLICT (user_id, booking_batch_id, leg) DO UPDATE SET offer_id = EXCLUDED.offer_id, provider = EXCLUDED.provider, origin = EXCLUDED.origin, destination = EXCLUDED.destination, carrier_code = EXCLUDED.carrier_code, carrier_name = EXCLUDED.carrier_name, flight_number = EXCLUDED.flight_number, departure_at = EXCLUDED.departure_at, arrival_at = EXCLUDED.arrival_at, quoted_total_price = EXCLUDED.quoted_total_price, quoted_currency = EXCLUDED.quoted_currency, quoted_price_source = EXCLUDED.quoted_price_source, quoted_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, user_reported_booked = TRUE, user_reported_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
mapper.select: SELECT FROM flight_bookings WHERE trip_id = #{tripId} ORDER BY leg
SELECT FROM flight_bookings WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND trip_id IS NULL AND booking_batch_id IS NOT NULL AND user_reported_booked = TRUE ORDER BY created_at DESC, booking_batch_id, leg
SELECT FROM flight_bookings WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND booking_batch_id = #{bookingBatchId} ORDER BY leg
mapper.update: UPDATE flight_bookings SET user_reported_booked = #{userReportedBooked}, user_reported_at = CASE WHEN #{userReportedBooked} THEN CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ELSE NULL END WHERE trip_id = #{tripId} AND leg = #{leg}

UPDATE flight_bookings SET booking_ref = NULLIF(TRIM(#{bookingRef}), ''), booking_ref_added_at = CASE WHEN NULLIF(TRIM(#{bookingRef}), '') IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP END WHERE trip_id = #{tripId} AND leg = #{leg}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM flight_bookings WHERE trip_id = #{tripId} AND leg = #{leg}
